features.context: Palette open; query non-empty after trimming

B: spec/references/palette-search/shot.png shows query "new" with only New task (TASK), New list and New project (MANAGE) left. edge_cases: The needle is the trimmed query only; spaces inside the query are kept, so 'new  list' with two spaces matches only labels containing two spaces.
Only the label is searched (group names and accelerators are not matched).

Conflict: B's palette-search/tree.txt:105 records value="ne" while the screenshot shows query "new"; the tree and screenshot disagree. Per the source (A), the match uses the trimmed query and ranks earlier matches first; B could not observe trimming or ranking.

features.title: ArrowDown moves highlight down
features.result: Highlight moves down one row and stops at the last row. The default key action is prevented.
sources: A: CommandPalette.tsx:101-104 (setActive((a) => Math.min(a + 1, results.length - 1)); preventDefault at :103)

B: palette/meta.json and palette-search/meta.json contain no ArrowDown key events. The only active-row evidence is data-idx=0 active=true at palette/tree.txt:107. Nothing shows a move down or the clamp at the last row.

edge_cases: With no results, Math.min(a + 1, results.length - 1) evaluates to -1, so active becomes -1 rather than staying 0. Enter then runs runAt(-1), which returns early because results[-1] is undefined (CommandPalette.tsx:63-65). The code has no guard for the empty case.
features.check_notes: ArrowDown clamp at the last row is from source (A); B recorded no ArrowDown events and could not check it. Source shows the empty-results edge case.
